name: elysium-testnet-test-vault
_why: Cloak's test vault on Elysium testnet: Cloak's own copy of Gloam's open-source (MIT) guarded vault, with HYPE, USDC and KNTQ. Gloam agreed to it on Nov 13 on two conditions: testnet only, and never labelled as Gloam's vault anywhere users can see it. Deployed and controlled by the testnet main wallet.
_deployer: The testnet main wallet: it deploys the vault and runs its guard. The script checks DEPLOYER_PK is this address.
_poseidon: The PoseidonT3 already on testnet (Cloak's earlier Gloam instance and the launch vault use it). Its code is checked by Gloam's deploy.
_kntq: The test KNTQ deployed Nov 13 (18 decimals, anyone can mint, no owner). Drop `token` to deploy a fresh one.
_limits: HYPE and KNTQ at the limits Gloam has queued on its Elysium mainnet vault (12 / 600 HYPE, 1,400 / 70,000 KNTQ), so tests run mainnet's numbers.
_usdcLimits: Gloam's own testnet USDC limits (500 per deposit, 25,000 in total), as in its DeployElysiumTestnet script.
_withdrawFee: 0.5%, Gloam's mainnet cash-out fee, collected by the testnet main wallet.
_controller: The testnet main wallet runs the guard from the start (it is also the deployer, so nothing waits on an acceptance).
